task.title: Restoring your Red Hat Quay database
task.shortdesc: To restore your Red Hat Quay database from a backup, you can identify the database pod, upload the backup file, drop the existing database, and restore from the backup using psql. This procedure restores your database to a previous state using a backup SQL file.
